data.body: The editorial voice singleton declares how a tenant communicates: audience, tone, cadence, preferred and avoided language, claim boundaries, CTA rules, reader safety, and reusable article frameworks.
data.heading: editorial_voice

data.body:
Function

Editorial voice is governed data, not an instruction prompt. Agents and humans can read the same reviewable identity through the ordinary object surface, while the renderer keeps the record off public routes.

Required attributes

  • name, audience, tone, cadence define the publication’s reader-facing character.
  • lexicon carries preferred and avoided terms.
  • claim_policy, cta_policy, reader_safety_notes state content boundaries.
  • frameworks is a plural set of declared structures; default_framework must name one of them.

Operations and gates

The type is a one-per-site singleton edited with set_voice_fields. Creation is allowlisted, prompt-formatted text is rejected at write time, and publishing requires a current approval pinned to the exact action. In this Platform test, creation and review submission passed; an unapproved publish correctly returned approval_required.

Worked example

voice_platform defines a plain-spoken, evidence-led documentation voice with concept and runbook frameworks. It remains in open review until an authorized reviewer approves publication.
